label_groups.name: default

moon_form.name: InvoiceNumber
moon_form.instructions: Extract the invoice number.

moon_form.name: InvoiceDate
moon_form.instructions: Extract the date the invoice was issued.

moon_form.name: DueDate
moon_form.instructions: Extract the payment due date.

moon_form.name: CustomerName
moon_form.instructions: Extract the name of the customer (請求先 in Japanese, Bill To in English, Rechnungsempfaenger in German).

moon_form.name: VendorName
moon_form.instructions: Extract the name of the vendor (取引先 in Japanese, Vendor in English, Lieferant in German).

moon_form.name: RegistrationNumber
moon_form.instructions: Extract the registration number (登録番号 in Japanese, Vendor EIN in English, USt-IdNr. in German).

moon_form.name: SubtotalExclTax
moon_form.instructions: Extract the subtotal amount excluding tax (小計(税抜) in Japanese, Subtotal in English, Zwischensumme (Netto) in German). If a currency code is missing, assume the currency based on the document's language (JPY for Japanese, USD for English, EUR for German).

moon_form.name: TaxRate
moon_form.instructions: Extract the tax rate (消費税率 in Japanese, State Tax percentage in English, USt.-Satz in German). Include the percentage sign.

moon_form.name: TaxAmount
moon_form.instructions: Extract the tax amount (消費税額 in Japanese, Tax Amount in English, USt.-Betrag in German). If a currency code is missing, assume the currency based on the document's language (JPY for Japanese, USD for English, EUR for German).

moon_form.name: TotalAmount
moon_form.instructions: Extract the total amount (合計(税込) in Japanese, Total (USD) in English, Gesamtbetrag (Brutto) in German). If a currency code is missing, assume the currency based on the document's language (JPY for Japanese, USD for English, EUR for German).

moon_form.name: LanguageCode
moon_form.instructions: Determine the language of the entire invoice document and return one of the following ISO 639‑1 codes: 'JA'（Japanese）, 'EN'（English）, or 'DE'（German）.

label_defs.name: Invoice > LineItems
label_defs.instructions: Extract details for each line item on the invoice. Each row in the invoice's item list should be extracted as a separate entry.

moon_form.name: ItemDescription
moon_form.instructions: Extract the description of the item (品目 in Japanese, Description in English, Beschreibung in German).

moon_form.name: Quantity
moon_form.instructions: Extract the quantity of the item (数量 in Japanese, Quantity in English, Menge in German).

moon_form.name: UnitPriceExclTax
moon_form.instructions: Extract the unit price excluding tax (単価(税抜) in Japanese, Unit Price in English, Einzelpreis (Netto) in German). If a currency code is missing, assume the currency based on the document's language (JPY for Japanese, USD for English, EUR for German).
